target.name: Panelling, aluminium, window frame cover, wall opening, at plant

strategy.label: transcription drafted from the report excerpt by the LLM pipeline (reverse-bafu draft)
strategy.note: basis: Tabelle 10 'Sachbilanzdaten der Herstellung der Aluminiumbeplankung des Holz-Metallfensterrahmens pro m2 Rahmenflaeche im Licht, ab Werk', single column 'panelling, aluminium, window casement and frame cover, m2 visible, at plant' [CH]. The target dataset is instead expressed per m2 of WALL OPENING. The metadata gives the window as 1.75 m x 1.3 m = 2.275 m2 of wall opening with an average visible area of 0.29 m2, so one basis unit (1 m2 visible) corresponds to 2.275 / 0.29 = 7.845 m2 of wall opening.; allocation: none stated. Review every derivation; unreviewed entries have reviewed_by = null.

evidence.source: 2020 - LCA wooden windows and doors - Ramseier.pdf

gaps_reported_by_model: The excerpt's table is 'pro m2 Rahmenflaeche im Licht' (per m2 of visible frame area) and its product is named 'window casement AND frame cover', while the target dataset is 'window frame cover, WALL OPENING'. The report contains no table on the wall-opening basis, so the conversion had to be taken from the dataset metadata (1.75 m x 1.3 m window, 0.29 m2 average visible area) rather than from the excerpt. basis_amount = 7.845 encodes that; if the intended basis were instead 1 m2 of visible area, basis_amount would be 1 and every amount would be 7.845 times larger.
The target covers only the frame cover, while the table's product covers casement and frame cover together; the excerpt gives no split between the two.

Production losses are mentioned in the dataset's includedProcesses but no waste or disposal line appears in Tabelle 10 (unlike Tabelle 9 and Tabelle 11, which carry disposal and municipal waste collection lines).
No direct emissions are given for this process.
No rail transport line appears for the panelling, although the neighbouring tables carry one.
skipped_items: panelling, aluminium, window casement and frame cover, m2 visible, at plant: product — the reference product of Tabelle 10. Its name is 'window casement and frame cover, m2 visible', while the target dataset is 'window frame cover, wall opening' - see the basis field and the gaps.
